description: Predict churn risk for active subscriptions by analyzing payment history, subscription age, status, and activity patterns. Returns risk scores (0-100) and risk levels (low/medium/high/critical) with detailed factors.

limit.description: Optional: Maximum number of predictions to return (default: 50)

minRiskScore.description: Optional: Minimum risk score to include (0-100, default: 0)

storeId.description: Optional: Filter by specific store ID

name: predict_churn_risk
